labels.description: Adds a new passage on tariffs and other trade restrictions (higher input costs, disrupted supply chains, limited access to end markets, lower profitability, planning uncertainty) and narrows the PFAS customer-preference reference from "PFAS" to "third-party manufactured PFAS".
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 2: a new exposure (tariffs and trade restrictions) is disclosed, and the PFAS qualifier changes the scope of the customer-preference risk.

labels.description: "This ability" is reworded to "The ability to successfully bring new products to market" with the rest of the body unchanged.
labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording that spells out the antecedent with identical meaning.

labels.description: The named example of supplier-disrupting events changes from "military conflicts" to a cross-reference to "those noted in the first risk factor above" (now tariffs and trade restrictions), alongside minor rewording ("or terminated" moved, "shortage" to "shortages").
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 2: military conflicts is dropped as a disclosed cause of supplier interruption and trade restrictions are pulled in by reference, which is a change in substance rather than a pure cross-reference update.

labels.description: Only colons are inserted after "could" and "risk of" and page-number and table-of-contents markers move; the cybersecurity disclosure is otherwise identical.
labels.rationale: minor: punctuation and page-marker changes only.

labels.description: New risk factor on the Company's use of artificial intelligence: inaccurate or biased outputs, third-party AI vendor risks, leakage of confidential or third-party data into AI systems, evolving AI regulation, competitive pressure, and resulting legal, regulatory and reputational harm.

Drops the description of the structural reorganization (shrinking the corporate center, simplifying the supply chain, streamlining the geographic footprint, reducing management layers, aligning go-to-market models, and cutting manufacturing roles to match production volumes) and instead says workforce restructuring is "expected to deliver benefits, but also" impacts business groups, functions and geographies.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a specific named program (the structural reorganization and its stated components) is dropped from the disclosure.

labels.description: Only a page-number and table-of-contents marker is removed; the pension risk text is identical.
labels.rationale: minor: page-marker artifact with no change in wording.

labels.description: The S&P Global Ratings outlook on 3M's BBB+ rating changes from negative to stable, with cosmetic edits ("Fitch" to "Fitch Ratings", "expense" to "expenses").
labels.rationale: criterion 4 and 3: a credit rating outlook changes (negative to stable), softening the disclosed funding-cost risk.

labels.description: The cross-reference to the Commitments and Contingencies note changes from Note 19 to Note 17, with the CAE Settlement terms ($6.0 billion, 2023 to 2029, more than 99% participation) unchanged.
Removes the disclosed risk that consents or approvals required for the Solventum separation will not be obtained or will be obtained subject to material modifications to the underlying arrangement.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a previously disclosed risk is removed.
